f30766951f2abd63b5eb1113c7ed2155.overview: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.

f30fcf460d346a79e22e44fbe02772eb.overview: After witnessing a mysterious woman brutally slay a homemaker, prostitute Liz Blake finds herself trapped in a dangerous situation. While the police thinks she is the murderer, the real killer is intent on silencing her only witness.

f311460b73c79fde14d56035d20ac621.overview: During the housing shortage of the 1964 Summer Olympic Games, two men and a woman share a small apartment in Tokyo, and the older man soon starts playing Cupid to the younger pair.
f311460b73c79fde14d56035d20ac621.tagline: Run, don't walk to see Walk, Don't Run.

f3167cba956b812ef73c790cd5073851.overview: Two carefree castaways on a desert shore find an Arabian Nights city, where they compete for the luscious Princess Shalmar.
f3167cba956b812ef73c790cd5073851.tagline: You'll Shriek At These Shieks! . . . trying the double - Oh! on Sheikess Dorothy Lamour!

f331928de715ec87f6a8c34d0e0eb8f2.overview: After an unappreciated minister dies, his daughter loses her faith in God, prompting her to open a phony temple with a con man. Can the love of a blind former aviator restore her faith and happiness?
f331928de715ec87f6a8c34d0e0eb8f2.tagline: Romance of a glorious girl who betrayed her faith-but could not deceive her love!

f3521a6b5f948d0e37085e3ee51c3d0c.overview: A look at the daily business of U.S. President John F. Kennedy, with a focus on some of the political issues he faces six weeks into his term.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in 2007.

f35608f6bcfa402183d09ec20301c45e.overview: The dashing Captain Hugh "Bullshot" Crummond - WWI ace fighter pilot, Olympic athlete, racing driver, part-time sleuth and all round spiffing chap - must save the world from the dastardly Count Otto van Bruno, his wartime adversary. And, of course, win the heart of a jolly nice young lady.
f35608f6bcfa402183d09ec20301c45e.tagline: Athlete, Adventurer, War Hero... And A Hit With The Ladies

f3894c88c80a14c6980fb7735ccece61.overview: Frustrated when network brass reject his sitcom idea, producer Pierre Delacroix pitches the worst idea he can think of in an attempt to get fired: a 21st century minstrel show. The network not only airs it, but it becomes a smash hit.
f3894c88c80a14c6980fb7735ccece61.tagline: A Spectacular Film by Mr. Spike Lee

f3a02f1d6e2a8040728957593a86a861.overview: A futuristic love story set in a world where emotions have been eradicated.

f3a5461830b19c02482b98866e523873.overview: Career criminal Johnny Clay recruits a sharpshooter, a crooked police officer, a bartender and a betting teller named George, among others, for one last job before he goes straight and gets married. But when George tells his restless wife about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own.
f3a5461830b19c02482b98866e523873.tagline: In all its fury and violence...

f3b1f37115a024b29a036521ed5d5502.overview: While grieving a terrible loss, a married couple meet two mysterious sisters, one of whom gives them a message sent from the afterlife.

f3e65e682173aa5ea3a095cee6819d14.overview: Traveling businessman David Mann angers the driver of a rusty tanker while crossing the California desert. A simple trip turns deadly, as Mann struggles to stay on the road while the tanker plays cat and mouse with his life.
f3e65e682173aa5ea3a095cee6819d14.tagline: The most bizarre murder weapon ever used!

f3eaadf0a7e668a14157da9808da10aa.overview: In 1930s Prague, a Czech cremator who firmly believes cremation relieves one from earthly suffering is drawn inexorably to Nazism.
